about: Invented daily review notes for a made-up person, Sam, written for the journal search evaluation. daysAgo is relative to the day the evaluation runs.

notes.text: Went for a 5k run before work. Knee held up fine and I felt sharp all morning.
Completely drained after six back-to-back meetings. Ate a sandwich at my desk.
Physio says the knee is improving; keep the long runs under 10k for another fortnight.
Nailed the sprint demo. The team clapped and my manager asked me to present it again on Friday.
Restless night, awake at 3am going over the release plan.
Studied VPC peering and transit gateways for two hours. Finally makes sense.
Dinner at mum's with my brother. Lovely to switch off for an evening.
Scrolled my phone for an hour instead of starting the AWS module. Annoyed with myself.
Sunny, warm evening walk by the canal cleared my head after a tense day.
Third coffee by noon and a takeaway for dinner again. Need to plan meals.
Clashed with Priya about the API design. We agreed to prototype both options.
Came down with a cold, sore throat and a headache. Worked from bed.
Still feverish. Slept most of the day and skipped everything.
Practice exam 1: 68%. Networking questions were the weakest by far.
First physio session for the knee. Lots of glute exercises, no running for a week.
Ten minutes of breathing exercises before bed helped me settle. Fell asleep quickly.
Drowning in support tickets and the deadline moved forward. Stayed until 8pm.
Booked the half marathon for April. Nervous but excited.
Heated debate with my sister about the holiday plans. Hung up annoyed.
Lunch with Priya, she shared her notes from the SA associate exam.
Kept putting off the tax return. Did laundry, cleaned the oven, anything but.
Running on empty. Skipped breakfast and lunch, only biscuits and coffee.
Blue skies all day. Long cycle along the coast with friends.
Finally finished the IAM policies chapter. Proud I stuck with it all month.
Video call with my grandparents; they want to visit in the summer.
Too many meetings again; did no real work until 4pm.
Knee pain after the long run. Booked a physio appointment.
Insomnia again, maybe from the late espresso.
Meditated for 15 minutes in the morning; the whole day felt calmer and slower.
Wiped out after the trip home. Napped on the train.
Signed up for the AWS Solutions Architect course and set a study plan.
Got positive feedback from the client on the dashboard I built. A good day.
Rainy and grey. Stayed in and read.
Cooked a proper dinner for the first time in weeks. Felt good to eat well.
Ran 12k with the club; knee a bit sore afterwards.
Avoided starting the report until 3pm, then rushed it.
Visited my brother's new flat and helped him paint.
Knackered after a week of late releases.
Woke up feeling rested for once. Early night paid off.
Planned the year: AWS certificate, half marathon, more reading.
